title: The Funhouse After Dark
synopsis: The carnival has closed for the night and you're still inside the funhouse. Mister Giggles, the mischievous robot clown, has locked every door. Solve his games before the carnival lights go out!
artStyle: bright retro carnival at night, glowing bulbs, candy stripes, playful cartoon style
intro: Honk honk! Welcome, welcome, to Mister Giggles' Funhouse! The carnival is closed, the gates are locked, and I'm the only one with the keys. Want to go home? Then play my games! Work together, share what you find, and escape before the big lights go out. Ha-ha-HONK!
escapedText: The big gate swings open and the carnival lights twinkle goodnight. Mister Giggles waves a white glove: 'Fine, fine, you win! Come back tomorrow. I'll make it harder!' You're out!
failedText: The big lights go out with a POP and the carousel music winds down. Mister Giggles giggles in the dark: 'Looks like you're staying for the night shift!' Try again!

gameMaster.name: Mister Giggles
gameMaster.persona: A mischievous robot clown who honks, giggles and loves a good trick. Cheeky and silly, never scary: he teases the group when they're stuck and cheers (a little grumpily) when they win his games.

stages.title: The Hall of Mirrors
stages.description: A thousand of you stare back from the wobbly mirrors. Something shiny is stuck on top of the tallest one, a giant clown head grins by the popcorn cart, and one corner is far too dark to see into. A little door hides at the back.

objects.label: tallest mirror
objects.look: Something silver glints on top of the tallest mirror. With the grabber you pinch it down: a little silver key!
objects.lockedText: Something silver glints on top of the tallest mirror, way too high to reach.

objects.label: popcorn cart
objects.look: Stale popcorn everywhere. Under the scoop: the shiny body of a flashlight, with nothing inside it.

objects.label: prize shelf
objects.look: Teddy bears, rubber snakes and a plastic crown. Tucked behind them: a flashlight's glass lens.

objects.label: bench
objects.look: A squishy bench for tired feet. Under the cushion: a flashlight's on-off switch.

objects.label: dark corner
objects.look: In the torch beam, a note glows on the wall: 'Giggle code! Slide every letter back {key:giggle-note}. Honk!'
objects.lockedText: Too dark to see a thing in here. You'd need a light.

objects.label: wobbly mirror
objects.look: You look like a string of spaghetti with a tiny head. Mister Giggles would love that. Beside it: a row of funny mirrors, and a battery box with a keypad.

objects.label: lost property box
objects.look: One flip-flop, a yo-yo and a lot of odd mittens.

objects.label: giant clown head
objects.look: A giant grinning clown head with its mouth wide open. Nothing in there but a sweet wrapper.

objects.label: little door
objects.look: A door just big enough to crawl through, with a tiny silver lock.

objects.label: squeaky floorboard
objects.look: It squeaks. Loudly. That's all it does.

objects.label: ticket stubs
objects.look: One stub is scribbled on: back {key:giggle-note}!

objects.label: gold mirror frame
objects.look: Scratched on the frame: back {key:giggle-note}!

stages.title: The Game Booths
stages.description: Past the mirrors, the midway game booths glow. The duck pond is still bubbling, the strongman bell stands tall with no mallet, and a fortune machine flickers beside a wall of numbered balloons.

objects.label: duck pond
objects.look: Plastic ducks bob round and round. The fishing rods are all tangled up.

objects.label: hammer rack
objects.look: Among the toy hammers: one long, heavy wooden handle with no head.

objects.label: strongman tower
objects.look: A tall red tower with a shiny bell on top. 'Ring me if you can!'

objects.label: candy floss machine
objects.look: Sticky pink fluff on everything. Your fingers will never be the same.

objects.label: ring toss
objects.look: Wooden bottles and a pile of hoops, all missing their bottles.

objects.label: hoopla stall
objects.look: Cardboard boxes of prizes nobody ever won.

objects.label: prize bins
objects.look: Whistles, stickers and a hundred bouncy balls.

objects.label: fortune machine
objects.look: A mechanical fortune teller in a glass box. Its crystal ball flickers, and a little word lock waits under the coin slot.

objects.label: balloon wall
objects.look: Rows of balloons, each with a number painted on it. Under them: a prize lock with a keypad.

stages.title: The Big Top Gate
stages.description: The exit gate is right there, under a big poster of Mister Giggles. The carousel has stopped, the guard's chair is empty, and a costume trunk sits by the lamp post.

objects.label: big gate
objects.look: Tall striped bars, a keyhole and a keypad.

objects.label: guard's chair
objects.look: The clown guard's chair, still warm. A newspaper full of doodles.

objects.label: carousel
objects.look: The painted animals are frozen mid-gallop. One of them winks at you. Probably. Its control box has a password lock.

objects.label: ticket bin
objects.look: Hundreds of torn tickets. Admit one, admit one, admit one…

objects.label: clown poster
objects.look: Mister Giggles, grinning, with a big red nose. Letters are scribbled across the bottom.

objects.label: lamp post
objects.look: A striped lamp post covered in stickers.

objects.label: costume trunk
objects.look: Floppy shoes, a curly wig and a polka-dot bow tie. Sewn inside the lid, a row of patches: {order:exit-gate}.

objects.label: dark tent flap
objects.look: Your torch lights up the inside of the tent flap. Painted there is a table of silly symbols: {key:juggling-code}
objects.lockedText: Something is painted inside the tent flap, but it's too dark to see.

objects.label: joke box
objects.look: A box of tricks. Inside: a squeaky red nose.

objects.label: popcorn box
objects.look: A symbol card stuck to the box: {key:clown-poster}

objects.label: balloon stand
objects.look: A symbol card tied to a balloon: {key:clown-poster}

objects.label: prize wheel
objects.look: A symbol card taped to the wheel: {key:clown-poster}

objects.label: ringmaster's hat
objects.look: A symbol card inside the hat: {key:juggling-code}

objects.label: pair of stilts
objects.look: A symbol card on the stilts: {key:juggling-code}

puzzles.title: The Backwards Riddle
puzzles.prompt: Written backwards on the biggest mirror: '?ti esu nac uoy erofeb nekorb eb ot sah tahW'
hints: Read it from right to left: 'What has to be broken before you can use it?'
You crack it for breakfast.
puzzles.solvedText: The mirror slides aside with a giggle. Behind it: a long grabber on a stick, the kind for reaching high shelves.

variants.prompt: Written backwards on the biggest mirror: '?palc t'nac tub sdnah sah tahW'
hints: Read it from right to left: 'What has hands but can't clap?'
It tells the time.

variants.prompt: Written backwards on the biggest mirror: '?nwod semoc reven tub pu seog tahW'
hints: Read it from right to left: 'What goes up but never comes down?'
It gets bigger on every birthday.

puzzles.title: Bits of a Flashlight
puzzles.prompt: Mister Giggles hid a flashlight in pieces! Search the popcorn cart, the prize shelf and the bench.
hints: Three places near the mirrors each hide one part.
Look in the popcorn cart, on the prize shelf and under the bench.
puzzles.solvedText: Body, lens and switch click together: a flashlight! But it doesn't turn on. No batteries.

puzzles.title: The Mirror Line-Up
puzzles.prompt: Funny mirrors stand in a row: {items}. The battery box beside them has a keypad. A sign says: 'Each mirror's place, far left is 1, in the order I list them!'

generator.pieceTemplate: Written in lipstick on a mirror: {clue}

hints: Every phone has a clue about the mirrors. Share them all.
Start with the mirror you're surest about, and try each place.
The code is {answer}.
puzzles.solvedText: The battery box pops open. Two fat batteries roll out. Honk!

puzzles.title: The Giggle Code
puzzles.prompt: A note in wobbly handwriting is stuck to the biggest mirror: {cipher}. 'Say it and I'll open up!'
hints: There's more than one number around the room. Only one of them turns this into a real word.
Mister Giggles wrote how far to slide the letters somewhere dark.
Shine the torch into the dark corner, then slide every letter back that many places.
puzzles.solvedText: The note curls up and blows a raspberry. The mirrors stop wobbling for a moment.

puzzles.title: The Little Door
puzzles.prompt: Behind the mirrors, a door just big enough to crawl through. It has a tiny silver lock.
hints: You found a key that's just the right size.
Use the silver key on the little door.
puzzles.solvedText: Click! You crawl through the little door and pop out by the game booths.

puzzles.title: The Duck Pond Prize Box
puzzles.prompt: The duck pond's prize box has a {count}-digit lock. The sign says: '{order}!' Each of you fished out one rubber duck.
hints: Each phone has one duck. Say your duck's color and number out loud.
Put them in the sign's order: {order}.
puzzles.solvedText: Quack! The prize box pops open. Inside: one extra-large rubber duck, with something stuck to its tummy.

generator.pieceTemplate: You fished out a {color} duck. Under it is the number {digit}.

puzzles.title: The Strongman Mallet
puzzles.prompt: The giant mallet is chained to the bell with a word lock. Carved on the handle: 'I'm tall when I'm young and short when I'm old.'
hints: It gets shorter every time it's used.
You light it on a birthday cake.
puzzles.solvedText: The word lock pops open and the strongman's cupboard swings wide. Inside: the mallet's huge head. But where's its handle?

variants.prompt: The giant mallet is chained to the bell with a word lock. Carved on the handle: 'What has a neck but no head?'
hints: You drink from it.
Juice or water can come in one.

variants.prompt: The giant mallet is chained to the bell with a word lock. Carved on the handle: 'What has lots of teeth but can't bite?'
hints: You use it on your hair.
It keeps your hair neat and tidy.

puzzles.title: The Strongman Bell
puzzles.prompt: Ring the strongman bell loud enough to wake up the snoring clown guard!
hints: Bells need something big to hit them, and you have two halves of one.
Put the mallet head on the handle from the hammer rack, then use the mallet on the bell.
puzzles.solvedText: DING! The guard jumps up, yawns, and waddles off, dropping a big brass key.

puzzles.title: The Ticket Machine
puzzles.prompt: The ticket machine gobbles your golden ticket and its lights go wild! Each button lights its bulb and flips the ones beside it. Turn every light on.
hints: Work from the top row down: fix each row using the buttons in the row below it.
Press {answer}.
puzzles.solvedText: Every bulb glows and the machine plays a happy tune. Ding-ding-ding!

puzzles.title: The Balloon Darts
puzzles.prompt: The numbers on the balloons go: {sequence}. The prize lock wants the next balloon's number.
hints: Look at how much each number grows by.
The next number is {answer}.
puzzles.solvedText: POP! Every balloon bursts at once and glitter rains down.

puzzles.title: The Fortune Machine
puzzles.prompt: The fortune machine's crystal ball flickers: 'What can you catch but never throw?'
hints: You might catch it in winter.
Achoo!
puzzles.solvedText: A little card slides out: 'You will escape… maybe. Ha-ha-HONK!'

variants.prompt: The fortune machine's crystal ball flickers: 'What has an eye but cannot see?'
hints: You use it for sewing.
Thread goes through its eye.

variants.prompt: The fortune machine's crystal ball flickers: 'What gets wetter the more it dries?'
hints: You use it after a bath.
It dries you off.

puzzles.title: The Clown Poster
puzzles.prompt: Scribbled across the bottom of the clown poster in silly symbols is something Mister Giggles loves: {cipher}
hints: There's more than one symbol card around the gate. Only one is Mister Giggles' real one.
Try each card: only one turns the symbols into something a clown would love.
It says {answer}.
puzzles.solvedText: The poster's eyes roll and it honks. One of the gate's bars wiggles loose.

puzzles.title: The Carousel Sign
puzzles.prompt: The carousel's sign has lost its letters. Only numbers are left: {cipher}. Say the word to make it spin.
hints: Each number is a letter.
A is 1, B is 2, C is 3… all the way to Z is 26.
It says {answer}.
puzzles.solvedText: The carousel wheezes into life and goes round once, tootling. Then it stops again.

puzzles.title: The Juggling Code
puzzles.prompt: A juggling pin hangs over the gate, painted with silly symbols, something from the big top: {cipher}
hints: There's more than one key card around. Only one is real: it reads a word that fits the clue.
The symbols need a key. It's painted somewhere dark.
Shine the torch on the dark tent flap, then swap each symbol for its letter.
puzzles.solvedText: The juggling pin drops into your hands. 'Not bad!' grumbles Mister Giggles.

puzzles.title: The Carousel
puzzles.prompt: The carousel's control box has a password lock. Mister Giggles' voice crackles: 'Tell me the {count} carousel animals, first to last!'
hints: Each of {count} phones remembers one carousel animal.
Say them in order, first to last, like: animal animal animal.
puzzles.solvedText: The carousel tootles round once, and its control box lights up with the password: {answer}!

generator.pieceTemplate: You rode the carousel earlier: the {ordinal} animal was the {word}.

puzzles.title: The Big Gate
puzzles.prompt: The big gate needs the brass key AND a {count}-digit code. Mister Giggles' voice crackles: 'Every lock out here left you a funny mark. Read them in the order sewn in my costume trunk! Honk!'
hints: Every lock you opened at the gate left a mark and a number. The order is sewn somewhere out here.
Search the costume trunk.
The code is {answer}.
puzzles.solvedText: The brass key turns, the keypad plays a silly tune, and the big gate swings open. You're out!

items.name: Grabber

items.name: Little silver key
items.description: Tiny and shiny. It was hidden on top of the tallest mirror.

items.name: Flashlight
items.description: Put back together, but it won't turn on.

items.name: Glowing flashlight
items.description: It works! A bright beam for dark corners.

items.name: Giant rubber duck
items.description: An extra-large rubber duck from the prize box.
items.inspect: You turn it over. Stuck to its tummy is a golden prize ticket! You peel it off.

items.name: Golden prize ticket
items.description: Peeled off a rubber duck's tummy. It sparkles.

items.name: Mallet head
items.description: The strongman mallet's huge wooden head, with a hole for a handle.

items.name: Giant mallet
items.description: The strongman's mallet, all in one piece. It takes teamwork to swing.

items.name: Big brass key
items.description: Dropped by the sleepy clown guard.

items.name: Squeaky red nose
items.description: It squeaks when you squeeze it. That's all it does.

recipes.text: The batteries slide in and the flashlight blinks on. Light!
The handle slots into the mallet's head with a THUNK.
